items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: And [Ray Benner], garbled Basit, said you're coming up to play some brushes on the next set, and I said, never

ctx.x: around Kansas City at the time will tell you, it's impossible to tell people how awe inspiring it was. Jo Jones will tell you and those people that are fortunate enough to still be alive -- the music was just too much, it was too much to absorb.

And [Ray Benner], garbled Basit, said you're coming up to play some brushes on the next set, and I said, never -- you know, I had just heard Jo Jones and I didn't know anything existed like this. Now I never told that to many people.
Jo has always said so many beautiful things about you. It's nice to hear you say all of this.
